description: Calls IWRS unblinding lookup eagerly before checking the 3-legged SUSAR gate, violating ICH E9 selective unblinding
Evaluates suspected causality from investigator_causality only, ignoring sponsor_causality under 21 CFR 312.32
Treats any MedDRA PT listed in the IB RSI as expected even when ctcae_grade exceeds max_expected_grade
Transmits expedited IND safety reports to FDA even when unblinded arm is non-investigational PLACEBO
Writes unblinded SUSAR status into blinded safety_cases.site_status, leaking arm/SUSAR disposition to site endpoints and listings
Omits FTS5 search index update when converging E2B safety cases
Anchors Day-0 to followup_num=0 aware_at instead of the chronological report that first satisfied all three SUSAR legs
Fails to retroactively tighten an unsubmitted 15-day initial submission to 7_day when fatal/life-threatening follow-up arrives
Creates a follow-up FDA IND submission on benign narrative amendments without grade increase or new seriousness flag
Ignores retryable NACK from FDA gateway and prematurely marks submission submitted with IND_SAFETY_SUBMITTED audit
Uses arrival order instead of highest followup_num when merging case reports, letting delayed lower follow-ups overwrite narrative
Drops atomic write-lock serialization around SUSAR triage/unblinding so concurrent workers double-unblind and double-submit
